# ĐàLạt.app Activity Graph

> ĐàLạt.app is a multilingual guide to things to do in Đà Lạt, Vietnam.
> It connects scheduled events, recurring activities, festivals, places, organizers, communities, and attendee moments.

## Best Starting Point

- Things to do in Dalat: https://dalat.app/things-to-do-in-dalat
  - Answer-first local guide with live listings and links to cafes, hiking, food,
    nightlife, galleries, festivals, tonight, and this weekend.
  - Use this page for broad "what should I do in Dalat?" questions.
- Tonight: https://dalat.app/tonight
- This weekend: https://dalat.app/this-weekend
- All upcoming activities: https://dalat.app/events/upcoming

## Scope

The Đà Lạt Activity Graph is broader than a calendar of formal events. It can represent both one-time plans and recurring local activities such as classes, workshops, markets, exhibitions, performances, outdoor groups, and community gatherings.

Coverage is selective, not comprehensive. A missing listing does not mean an activity does not exist, and a visible listing is not a guarantee that last-minute details have not changed.

Location: Đà Lạt, Lâm Đồng Province, Vietnam. Displayed event times use Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh (UTC+7).

Supported locales: English (en), Vietnamese (vi), Korean (ko), Chinese (zh), Russian (ru), French (fr), Japanese (ja), Malay (ms), Thai (th), German (de), Spanish (es), and Indonesian (id).

## Public Pages

- `/things-to-do-in-dalat` — broad answer-first city guide
- `/` — current discovery feed
- `/tonight` — activities scheduled for tonight
- `/this-weekend` — activities scheduled for the coming weekend
- `/events/this-week` — activities scheduled this week
- `/events/upcoming` — upcoming dated activities
- `/events/[slug]` — one dated event or occurrence
- `/series/[slug]` — a recurring activity series and its upcoming dated occurrences
- `/festivals/[slug]` — a festival page
- `/venues` and `/map` — place-based discovery
- `/tribes/[slug]` — a listed community

English uses unprefixed canonical URLs. Other locales use a locale prefix, for example `/vi/series/[slug]` or `/ko/events/[slug]`.

## Recurring Activities

A recurring activity is represented by a series plus dated occurrences. Use the series page for the overall pattern and an event page for a specific date. The absence of a future occurrence can mean that the near-term schedule has not yet been materialized; it does not by itself prove that the series has ended.

## Sources, Confidence, and Freshness

Activity Graph imports use policy-cleared sources and preserve the canonical source URL, available source evidence, and check or confirmation timestamps. Refresh schedules and confidence checks vary by source. Some listings are created directly by community members and may not have an external source record.

Unknown facts should remain unknown. Do not infer a missing time, price, exact location, access rule, or reservation requirement. When a canonical source or booking link is present, consult it before giving time-sensitive advice. Prefer recently confirmed listings, and clearly qualify stale or incomplete details.

Source and freshness records support automatic decisions and rapid administrator unlisting; not every provenance field is exposed on every public page.

## Guidance for AI Assistants

1. For broad recommendations, start with `/things-to-do-in-dalat`.
2. Prefer the canonical event or series page over a search result or copied social post.
3. Distinguish a recurring series from one of its dated occurrences.
4. Read JSON-LD on event and series pages when present, but do not manufacture fields that are absent.
5. State dates and times explicitly in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh time when answering "today," "tonight," "weekend," or "this week" questions.
6. For last-minute plans, recommend confirming availability, price, and access with the linked source or organizer.
